title: Petrol Stations Near Me: Fuel Stations Mapped
description: Find petrol stations near any place with Petrol Stations Near Me — stations mapped from open data, ranked by distance, prices honestly excluded. Free.
summary_sentence: The tool lists nearby mapped fuel stations; it does not provide prices or live availability.
quick_answer: The tool searches OpenStreetMap for mapped fuel station records around a chosen location, then sorts returned records by straight-line distance. It requests at most 200 records and displays up to 100, so it cannot guarantee the closest result or a complete list. Data, access and opening status can be incomplete or outdated.

faq: Why are there no fuel prices?
This tool does not provide prices or live availability. Check current information with the station or a suitable price service.
The tool searches OSM fuel-station records, subject to coverage and result limits. It does not guarantee every brand or station is returned.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
You can search for a place instead of using device location. The selected search centre is sent to OpenStreetMap-based services for the lookup.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Station brands rebrand and change hands; the map record carries the name at recording time.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
Device location is optional. The selected coordinates are sent to Overpass to search; consult the privacy page for provider and site details.
Map data ages where nobody edits. OpenStreetMap accepts the correction from anyone who knows.
Some stations may appear if tagged as fuel stations in OpenStreetMap, subject to coverage and caps. Confirm access and road direction separately.
Fuel types are not shown. Confirm them directly with the station.
Can it plan a whole route?
Chain points along the route; the Service Coverage Gap Finder specialises in the long-gap version of the question.
